# A long page

A page with enough sections to need a list of them.

## Install

How it is installed. This paragraph is here to give the page some length, so that a reader has to scroll to reach the next section and the list of contents has something to follow.

A second paragraph, for the same reason. Nothing in it matters beyond the room it takes up on the page.

And a third, since a section that fits on one screen with its neighbours cannot show which of them is being read.
